## Summary

Describe what this change does and why.

## Boundary check

- [ ] Stays local and deterministic (no default network, scraping, or LLM calls)
- [ ] Does not add truth verification or source-ranking authority
- [ ] Does not add investment, trading, allocation, or target-price advice
- [ ] No private, copyrighted, or market-sensitive sample data added

## Testing

- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes locally
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the changed behavior (or explained why not)

## Notes

Anything reviewers should know: tradeoffs, follow-ups, or open questions.
